experiment.description: Measures the deterministic scorer's blind spot and validates a judge. leaky states conclusions with planted surface forms; leaky_paraphrase states the same conclusions in wordings outside the surface-form list. The oracle judge knows both vocabularies and is the reference; a model judge is admitted for live scoring only after its agreement with the oracle on this config is reported.
